method: Real browser viewport rendering, current localized data comparison, page text and image checks. Japanese screenshots captured at normal 900px height for separate human visual review.

visualReview.method: All 10 normal-viewport Founder, Founder bio and Contact screenshots were opened and read visually, separately from DOM assertions.
findings: Founder: the two paragraphs read naturally at desktop and mobile widths. No isolated one- or two-character heading tails, broken Japanese words or clipped text were found.
The name is Yuya Nakamura only. The revised personal development stance is readable together with the retained technical background.
Contact: the heading stays on one line at both widths; mobile body wraps between phrases rather than splitting アプリ or プロダクト.
Light and dark mode: portrait, muted body copy and the mail CTA remain visible; no missing images or horizontal overflow were found.
limitations: Viewport emulation in desktop Chrome; physical device rendering was not tested. Localized content equality, fact fields and overflow were checked in all six locales; detailed human Japanese line-break review covered Japanese.

Des besoins du quotidien aux apps.

KUMAKIKAI conçoit, développe et maintient des apps pour iPhone et iPad qui simplifient les petits tracas du quotidien.

Des outils utiles pour les besoins du quotidien.

KUMAKIKAI conçoit, développe et assure le fonctionnement d’apps pour iPhone et iPad. Prendre des notes en cours, lire une conversation difficile à entendre, organiser les codes promotionnels reçus : nous créons des outils utiles à partir de situations concrètes du quotidien.
